Independent exact matrix-power reproduction and direct decimal streaming for the base case
correctness.rationale: Appending an e-digit integer acts on (v,k,1) by the upper-triangular matrix with rows (10^e,1,0), (0,1,1), (0,0,1). Over F₇ its sixth power is unipotent of index at most three, hence the 42nd power is the identity; lifting I+7K to its seventh power gives identity modulo 49. The order of 10 modulo 49 is 42 (powers 21,14,6 are 48,30,8). For e≥2, increasing e by 42 leaves the matrix and starting integer unchanged modulo 49, the iteration count unchanged modulo 294 by the Chinese remainder theorem, and e times that count unchanged modulo 42. Independent modular matrix powering and composition of widths 2 through 43 gave (a,b,length)=(1,0,0) modulo (49,49,42). This cycle can start after width four by cyclic conjugation of invertible maps. The computed state through 9999 was (28,39), then appending the first nine width-five integers gave (14,0), independently confirmed by a direct decimal stream through 10008. The nine-integer tail is identical in these residues at every specified width. A rotation moving h digits gives C′≡10^h C modulo 49 because 42 divides the length, so v₇(C′)=1 for every block rotation. This proves the exclusion for every integer power exponent at least two.
residual_risks: The finite reproduction establishes the transfer identity and base pair; the lifting and periodicity argument, not further sampled indices, establishes the infinite range.
